name: Understanding inheritance - - Platform guide - Toast Tab
snippet: For example, menus, menu groups, and menu items all have settings for tax rates, prep stations, courses, and sales categories but only menu items have settings for controlling stock count. For the settings that the menu entity types have in common, you can use inheritance to reduce the amount of work you have to do to configure your menus.
